title: CH-A8: core sufficiency check output
description: Phase B (prereg/v3-core-reduct-correction.md, tag prereg-p5-v3): checkers/sufficiency_check.py's output. Decides Definition 4 (sufficiency) for one candidate property set S -- normally the core (Definition 6) core_attributes already reports -- on one reachable set, by a certificate, never assumed. Exactly one of sufficiency_certificate/counterexample is present, matching is_sufficient.

model.description: Which reachable-set construction this check ran against, e.g. 'v2' (domain.executable_reachable_tuples_v2()) or a fixture name.

candidate_properties.description: Every property considered -- the universe tested_set is a subset of.

tested_set.description: The property set S whose sufficiency (Definition 4) this run decided -- normally core_attributes.

sufficiency_certificate.description: Present iff is_sufficient is true: the partition of the reachable set by projection onto tested_set, confirmed to carry a uniform verdict within every partition cell.

counterexample.description: Present iff is_sufficient is false: one concrete pair of reachable tuples agreeing on every property in tested_set with different M-verdicts.

reachable_tuples_swept.description: Count of reachable tuples the sufficiency check actually enumerated -- exhaustive, not sampled.
